digest.component_or_area: local-dev-env documentation and session testing guards
propositions: The docs/local-dev-env.md misfire list omits the session-level working-tree backstop from tests/conftest.py::pytest_sessionfinish
The pytest_sessionfinish backstop diffs git status across the whole session and fires once at session end, not per-test
The session-level backstop misfires on concurrent commits, rebases, branch switches, or editor saves—the same conditions as the per-test guards
Documentation must list the backstop alongside _no_repo_root_leaks and _no_repo_commits to give readers complete visibility into the guard family
The session backstop reports REPO ISOLATION FAILURE at run tail, not blamed to an arbitrary straddling test
